subject.title: feat(macos): render system chat option cards

question: Should macOS onboarding treat system-agent question payloads as native actionable cards once the branch provides live native proof for selection and Skip behavior?
rationale: This is a new core macOS interaction surface, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision beyond test-only validation.

options.title: Accept after native proof
options.body: Require a redacted signed-app recording or runtime transcript showing card selection and Skip complete the expected chat flow, then review the exact head.

options.title: Keep prose-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new card interaction and retain the existing text-only system-agent chat contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after native proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted signed-app recording or runtime transcript showing card selection and Skip complete the expected chat flow, then review the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor authored the current macOS implementation and follow-up revisions.
